from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image

Xo=[]; Xr=[]
for k in sorted(orel):
 a=np.asarray(Image.open(orel[k]).convert('RGBA'),dtype=np.int16); b=np.asarray(Image.open(rrel[k]).convert('RGBA'),dtype=np.int16)

 drgb=np.max(np.abs(a[:,:,:3]-b[:,:,:3]),axis=2); da=np.abs(a[:,:,3]-b[:,:,3]); ch=(drgb>=2)|(da>=2)

 roi=ch[y0:y0+ph,x0:x0+pw]; inside_core.append(float(roi[core].mean()))

Xo=np.stack(Xo); Xr=np.stack(Xr)
def varstats(X,label):
 sd=X.std(axis=0).mean(axis=2)
 rg=(X.max(axis=0)-X.min(axis=0)).max(axis=2)
 for n,m in [('CORE',core),('MID',mid),('NZ',nz)]:
  print('VAR',label,n,'STD_MEAN',round(float(sd[m].mean()),4),'RANGE_MED',round(float(np.median(rg[m])),3),'RANGE_LE1',round(float((rg[m]<=1).mean()),6),'RANGE_P90',round(float(np.quantile(rg[m],.9)),3))

for name,v in [('GLOBAL_CHANGED_FRAC',global_fracs),('GLOBAL_RGB_MAD',global_mads),('ALPHA_CHANGED_FRAC',alpha_fracs),('EYE_CORE_CHANGED_FRAC',inside_core),('OUTSIDE_MASK_CHANGED_PIXELS_IN_EYE_RECT',outside_mask),('OUTSIDE_EYE_RECT_CHANGED_PIXELS',outside_rect)]:
 a=np.asarray(v,dtype=float); print(name,'MIN_MED_MEAN_P90_MAX',*[round(float(x),6) for x in [a.min(),np.median(a),a.mean(),np.quantile(a,.9),a.max()]])
